content:
As with anything in life, if you want to be good at something, you just need to put in the reps. I wrote about how I discovered and immediately fell in love with Oil Pastels in my previous post. So while I have the right mindset and time available right now, I’ll keep putting in the reps with the oil pastels, and just following YouTube tutorials to begin with.

Here’s the painting for tonight, thanks to this tutorial.

It’s quite minimal and has a ton of white space. I didn’t even post the pic of the entire sheet, and this is already zoomed in. Could have made it larger, but it’s not bad. Loved trying out this new style and maybe try out some more tutorials from the same channel where the person uses this theme a lot.

It was much easier and faster to make compared to the last one. Also managed to paint this while dabbling in some nostalgia and re-watching the 2001 Royal Rumble at the same time. God those were the good days!

Good night folks!
